title: Introducing PowerStore Elite: Built to Lead in an Unpredictable World
summary: Meet PowerStore Elite, Dell’s next-generation storage platform delivering breakthrough performance, greater density, smarter software, and future-ready efficiency.
body_markdown:
### When everything is changing, your platform can’t stand still


In 2026, the only constant is volatility. Predictability is gone, as AI drives non-linear data growth. NAND economics are shifting in real time. And pressure is mounting on teams to do more with less—with no margin for disruption.


You don’t just need a storage array.
You need a strategy that holds up over time.


Trusted by over 20,000 customers worldwide, and ranked #1 in ease of use for the third year in a row,¹ PowerStore is evolving again—so you can stay ahead of the unknown.


### Introducing PowerStore Elite


At[Dell Technologies World](https://www.dell.com/en-us/delltechnologiesworld/lp/2026-overview) , we’re introducing the most significant PowerStore advancement yet.[PowerStore Elite](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/powerstore/sf/power-store) combines next-generation hardware and software innovation to redefine what the platform can do — without changing the simplicity and versatility customers already trust.


We’re announcing:


- **Three new high-performance appliance models** (1500, 5500, 9500)
- Our most **intelligent software OS yet**
- A new **industry-leading 6:1 data reduction guarantee** ²


Together, these advancements help you meet today’s demands — and prepare for tomorrow’s.


### Breakthrough performance and efficiency


Compared to current models, PowerStore Elite delivers up to:


- **3x the IOPS³**
- **3x the throughput** 4
- **3x the density** 5


These are not incremental gains. They enable workload consolidation at a fundamentally different scale. PowerStore Elite lets you store up to **5.8 PB of effective capacity** in a single 3U appliance,6 so you can run *more* workloads on fewer systems — reducing footprint, power and cost per workload without performance tradeoffs.


The same platform improvements also raise our **industry-leading data reduction guarantee** from **5:1** to **6:1** , driven by advances in data-path efficiency and next-generation hardware acceleration. The result is more predictable, long-term storage economics that help customers offset rising media costs, even in supply-constrained environments.


### How did we do it?


PowerStore Elite is the result of coordinated engineering across the entire stack.


**Gen 3 hardware foundation**


The[newest PowerStore models](https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.storagereview.com/?post_type=review&p=155387&preview=true__;!!LpKI!loWWp1_moXlEzOU5ElYu312vtgC7ALnjwwIoCdBfLksY4Ha5Pn0Cm76bjJ148PDVGoFDRhdQtJUtJwjXPTz1_Q$) deliver major gains in future-ready performance and density.


- **Faster compute and memory**
Next-gen Intel CPUs with up to 50% more cores,7 DDR5 and PCIe Gen 5 for up to 4x more data bandwidth and a 20x faster node interconnect for quicker load balancing and failover.
- **Extreme density, without lock-in**
Industry-standard low-profile E3 NVMe media packs up to 40 drives in 3—improving efficiency while avoiding the supply constraints of proprietary modules.
- **Massive throughput and connectivity**
Up to 40 network ports (2x current generation), support for 64Gb FC and 100GbE—and an internal fabric designed for 128Gb FC and 200/400GbE speeds.


**Capacity / Density comparison**


### Smarter software


But hardware is only part of the story. PowerStore software has always set the platform apart — and with Elite, it does more than ever to unlock the full potential of your storage.


- **Software-based performance boost**
Data-path enhancements deliver up to 2x faster reads8 while reducing CPU overhead
- **Unified scale-up / scale-out** Seamless file and block mobility across clusters lets you consolidate all your workloads on a single platform
- **QLC or TLC on every model** Consistent performance across media types so you can optimize for cost or capacity with no tradeoffs—unlike approaches that treat QLC as a lower tier.
- **Data reduction enhancements**
Unaligned deduplication and improved compression offloads increase effective capacity while minimizing overhead.
- **Always-on resiliency** Native metro replication over FC or iSCSI enables zero-downtime SLAs for any workload, while integrated AIOps and new[Dell Cyber Detect](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/storage-servers-and-networking-for-business/sf/cyber-detect) 10 help detect and respond to ransomware threats early.


And it doesn’t stop there.


### Future-proof by design


Extreme headroom for today’s demands is just the starting point. PowerStore Elite is a **multi-generational architecture** , built to evolve non-disruptively as requirements change:


- **Modular hardware** ready for future CPU, I/O and media technologies
- **Container-based OS** designed for rapid software innovation, so PowerStore keeps advancing
- **Multi-generation clustering** to help existing customers seamlessly adopt new PowerStore advantages
- **Lifecycle Extension** that simplifies modernization with included upgrades and ongoing capacity discounts


## AI-powered simplicity


No matter how demands grow and change, Elite reduces manual effort by up to 95%9 with self-optimizing services that continuously tune performance and efficiency — so what starts simple stays simple.


And the automation extends beyond the array. PowerStore integrates seamlessly with the ecosystems you rely on — from[containers and virtualization](https://www.delltechnologies.com/asset/en-us/products/storage/briefs-summaries/dell-powerstore-powering-the-next-generation-of-virtualization.pdf) to hybrid cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, Nutanix and Equinix — so you can streamline workflows and deliver infrastructure as a service.


Best of all, with[Dell Private Cloud](https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/private-cloud/sf/private-cloud?hve=explore+private-cloud) software, you get end-to-end orchestration across compute, storage and networking — bringing consistency, flexibility and control across your entire environment, without lock-in.


### More than storage – it’s your foundation for what’s next


PowerStore Elite isn’t just a faster array. It’s the storage strategy for an unpredictable world — a platform to help you:


- **Consolidate** without compromise
- **Automate** the complex
- **Adapt** to the unknown


Don’t let constant change slow you down. Build on a foundation designed to lead.


**PowerStore Elite. Ready for anything.**


---

- PowerStore Gen 3 is now available through traditional purchase or a Dell APEX Infrastructure subscription.
